title: Small Bomb
body:
"Can be used to output a huge explosion, with a small radius. Any bombs which blow up other explosives will have a chain reaction, and explosives can be used to chop trees or break ores".

Description

The Small Bomb has a very powerful explosion, but a small radius. Like any other explosive, it damages trees and ores, and can be used to open the gate at the Skull Rock to get the Skull.

Unlike dynamite, bombs have a delayed chain reaction.

Trivia

  • The Small Bomb was originally priced at $5,000 and then $3,000
  • Most explodable walls require 2-3 Small Bombs.
